name: Stealing Money
overview: Stealing money is clearly condemned by Scripture, as God commands, "Thou shalt not steal" (Exodus 20:15). True wisdom and the fear of the Lord lead believers to obey His commandments, including honesty and integrity in financial matters (Psalms 111:10; Ecclesiastes 12:13). Even those who have wronged others can find life and restoration by returning what was taken and walking in God's statutes (Ezekiel 33:15). Faith and obedience to God's Word are foundational to living righteously, guarding against deceit and theft.
